Through Furniconcepts, Gebbwork executive desking, credenzas and director tables are available in Singapore with full space-planning support.

highlights.text: Configurable desking that grows with your team.

editorial.heading: Gebbwork: Furniture That Grows With Your Team
editorial.opening: Gebbwork exists for offices that don't yet know what they'll look like in two years. Its modular workstation systems are built to expand, shrink or reshuffle as your team changes, without the sunk cost of ripping out fixed furniture and starting over.
editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Gebbwork to clients who expect their headcount or floor plan to change: growing startups, offices mid-lease-renewal, or teams testing a new layout before committing to it permanently. Modular systems cost more upfront than fixed furniture, but they remove the cost of redoing the office every time the team changes shape.
editorial.background: Gebbwork's systems are built from interchangeable components, so a layout can expand, shrink or reconfigure as a team changes, without replacing the underlying furniture. It's specified as part of a wider office fit-out through Furniconcepts, alongside our other workstation and seating brands.

faq.q: Is modular office furniture actually worth the extra cost?
faq.a: If your headcount or floor plan will likely change within a few years, yes, you're paying for the ability to reconfigure instead of replace. If your office is genuinely static long-term, fixed furniture is usually cheaper.

faq.q: How often can a Gebbwork layout actually be reconfigured?
faq.a: As often as the components allow, there's no fixed limit like there would be with built-in furniture. Most clients reconfigure when headcount changes or a lease renewal prompts a redesign, not on a schedule.

faq.q: Does modular mean lower quality than fixed workstations?
faq.a: No, modularity is about how the pieces connect, not how well they're built. Gebbwork's systems are still built for daily commercial use, not a temporary or disposable product.

faq.q: Can Gebbwork workstations be mixed with other office brands in the same fit-out?
faq.a: Yes. We regularly specify Gebbwork alongside our other office chair and desk brands in the same project, coordinated through one delivery and installation schedule.

faq.q: Who installs and reconfigures a Gebbwork system after the initial fit-out?
faq.a: We do. If your layout needs to change later, reconfiguration can go through the same team that handled the original installation.

cta.heading: Built for the Office You'll Have in Two Years.
cta.text: Growing team or upcoming lease renewal? Tell us your floor plan and headcount plans, and we'll show you how Gebbwork adapts.

editorial.heading: Leadcom: Built for Scale, Priced for Bulk Orders
editorial.opening: When a project needs seats delivered on time and on budget, at scale, Leadcom is the name we reach for. It's been manufacturing public seating since 1998, and unlike many seating brands, tools 99% of its own components in-house rather than outsourcing to third parties.
editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Leadcom to clients working on a firm budget or a tight production timeline: multiplex cinemas, school halls, transport hubs, anywhere seat count and delivery reliability matter more than a boutique finish. Its 80,000-seat-a-month production capacity means large orders don't get stuck in a queue behind smaller ones.

faq.q: Can Leadcom handle a rush order for a large venue?
faq.a: Yes. Its factories produce roughly 80,000 seats a month, so large orders don't get stuck behind smaller ones the way they might with a boutique manufacturer.

faq.q: What's the real trade-off between Leadcom and a boutique seating brand?
faq.a: Leadcom tools 99% of its own components and tests for ergonomics; you're paying less because the factory runs at scale, not because corners are cut.

faq.q: Do you handle Leadcom orders yourselves, or pass them to a subcontractor?
faq.a: Furniconcepts handle them ourselves. Leadcom manufactures and ships; we manage specification and installation on the ground in Singapore.

faq.q: How does Leadcom pricing compare to boutique seating brands?
faq.a: The primary objective is to leverage volume to reduce the per-seat cost. Send us your seat count and venue type and we'll show you where it lands against other brands in our range.

cta.heading: Big Venue, Tight Timeline? Let's Talk Numbers.
cta.text: Furnishing a multiplex, school hall or transport hub in Singapore? Tell us your seat count and deadline, and we'll show you what Leadcom can do.

editorial.heading: Forma5: Where Sustainability Isn't Just a Marketing Page
editorial.opening: Forma5 doesn't just claim to be sustainable, it runs its Seville factory on 4,320 solar panels and makes every piece of furniture, packaging included, fully recyclable. That's the kind of commitment that shows up in a genuine sustainability audit, not just a marketing page.
editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Forma5 to clients whose procurement or ESG process actually checks sustainability claims, not just reads them, and to projects that want named-designer collections (Gabriel Teixidó, Mario Ruiz) rather than an anonymous catalogue range.
editorial.background: Forma5 operates a 60,000m² facility in Seville with more than 400 staff and a presence in over 30 countries. Its four product divisions, veneer, melamine, operational and metal furniture, and chairs, cover most of a corporate fit-out, and its collections are designed with named collaborators including Gabriel Teixidó and Mario Ruiz.

faq.q: Is Forma5 a Scandinavian furniture brand?
faq.a: No. Forma5 is Spanish, based in Dos Hermanas near Seville. It's sometimes associated with Scandinavian design due to its minimalist aesthetic, but the company and its manufacturing are Spanish.

faq.q: Does Forma5's sustainability claim actually hold up, or is it just marketing?
faq.a: It holds up. The Seville factory runs on 4,320 solar panels covering over 15,000m² of roof space, cutting an estimated 1,000 tonnes of CO2 a year, and every piece of furniture, packaging included, is fully recyclable.

faq.q: Is Forma5 a small design studio, or a serious manufacturer?
faq.a: A serious manufacturer. Forma5 runs a 60,000m² facility with over 400 staff and ships to more than 30 countries, not a boutique studio.

faq.q: Does Forma5 work with named furniture designers?
faq.a: Yes. Forma5 collaborates with designers including Gabriel Teixidó, Jorge Herrera and Mario Ruiz across its desk, chair and workstation collections.

faq.q: Does Furniconcepts import Forma5 furniture directly from Spain?
faq.a: Yes. Furniconcepts sources Forma5 furniture from Spain and handles local specification, delivery and installation for Singapore projects.

cta.heading: Sustainability You Can Actually Audit.
cta.text: Furnishing an office where ESG or design credentials matter? Tell us your project and we'll show you where Forma5 fits.

editorial.heading: Broad Power: The Layer Behind a Finished Desk
editorial.opening: Broad Power is the part of an office fit-out most people forget to budget for, until someone can't find a power outlet at their desk. It's a UK-based supplier of BS6396-compliant power and data products, with 25 years supplying office furniture manufacturers and dealers internationally.

atAGlance.label: Track record
atAGlance.value: 25 years supplying furniture manufacturers and dealers

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Broad Power to clients finalising a fit-out who haven't yet planned power and data access into the furniture itself, not as an afterthought bolted on later, but built into the desk from the start. It's also worth considering for hotel and education projects, not just standard offices.
editorial.background: Broad Power's range covers desk power modules, monitor arms and cable management: the accessory layer that finishes a fit-out after the desks and chairs are in place. Its products are also specified for hotel and education furniture projects, not just standard offices, anywhere built-in power access is needed.

faq.q: What is BS6396, and why does it matter for office power products?
faq.a: BS6396 is the British Standard governing power and data socket outlets built into furniture. It covers safety requirements for electrical systems integrated into desks and workstations. Broad Power's products comply with this standard.

faq.q: Is Broad Power just an office product, or does it work in other spaces?
faq.a: Both. We also specify it for hotel and education projects, anywhere built-in power access needs to be part of the furniture itself, not just standard office desks.

faq.q: How long has Broad Power been in this business?
faq.a: 25 years, supplying office furniture manufacturers and dealers across the UK and internationally, including through us in Singapore.

faq.q: What should I check before choosing a monitor arm or cable management system?
faq.a: VESA mount compatibility with your specific monitor, weight capacity, and whether the desk needs a clamp or grommet-style mount all affect fit. Confirming these upfront avoids ordering a component that doesn't match the desk it's going on.

faq.q: Can I just order Broad Power parts online?
faq.a: No, we handle it through direct quotes rather than an online store, so specification and pricing get confirmed against your actual project first.

cta.heading: The Layer Everyone Forgets to Budget For.
cta.text: Finalising an office fit-out and still working out power and cable management? Tell us your desk count and we'll scope it properly.

From solo phone booths to ensemble meeting pods with media walls, Furniconcepts configures and installs Musepod across Singapore workplaces.

editorial.heading: Musepod: Air Refreshes Every 90 Seconds, Not an Afterthought
editorial.opening: Musepod's pods refresh their internal air completely every 90 seconds and reduce noise by roughly 30 decibels, engineering details that matter more than most people think when they're going to sit in one for a two-hour call. Based in Shanghai, Musepod builds its range from FSC-certified and recycled materials, not standard particleboard.

atAGlance.label: Materials
atAGlance.value: FSC-certified boards, recycled components, tempered glass

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Musepod to clients who've had someone complain about a stuffy phone booth before. Its ventilation system is a genuine engineering feature, not a vent cut into the door, and its modular pod units can split or combine as your needs change.
editorial.background: Musepod's range runs from single-person focus pods to larger team meeting spaces, all built from FSC-certified boards and recycled components. Units use certified tempered glass and are professionally installed rather than flat-packed for self-assembly.

faq.q: Do Musepod pods actually have good ventilation, or just a small vent?
faq.a: Real ventilation: air inside a Musepod is fully refreshed roughly every 90 seconds, with sensors that activate lighting and airflow automatically when someone enters.

faq.q: How much noise does a Musepod actually block?
faq.a: Around 30 decibels of reduction, tested to the ISO 23351-1 method, enough to bring a normal speaking voice down to roughly whisper-level outside the pod.

faq.q: Are Musepod materials actually sustainable, or just marketed that way?
faq.a: Genuinely sourced that way: FSC-certified boards and recycled components across its range, not a single eco-friendly model within an otherwise standard line.

faq.q: Can Musepod units be resized or reconfigured after installation?
faq.a: Yes, its modular range is designed to split or combine, so a single-person pod setup can be adjusted toward larger meeting configurations later without starting over.

faq.q: Do you install Musepod units yourselves in Singapore?
faq.a: Yes. We handle import, placement planning and installation directly, and coordinate timing with your office layout.

cta.heading: Privacy Shouldn't Mean Stuffy Air.
cta.text: Planning acoustic pods for your Singapore office? Tell us your headcount and unit mix, and we'll scope it properly.

editorial.heading: Zumbooth: China's First GREENGUARD Gold Certified Pod Maker
editorial.opening: Zumbooth's parent company, Hecor, states it was the first in China to earn GREENGUARD Gold certification for its acoustic pods, a stricter tier than standard GREENGUARD. Originally an office partition wall manufacturer since 2012, Zum brings that construction-grade build quality, aviation-grade aluminum frames, into a product line that costs roughly half of building a permanent meeting room.

atAGlance.label: Certification
atAGlance.value: GREENGUARD Gold (manufacturer states first in China)

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Zumbooth specifically when budget is a real constraint but air-quality certification still matters. Its direct-factory OEM model also means faster customisation on colour and finish, over 200 combinations, without a long lead time.
editorial.background: Zumbooth operates under Hecor, which began manufacturing office partition walls in 2012 before moving into acoustic pods. Units use aviation-grade aluminum frames, are tested by SGS and ISO-accredited institutions, and include a simple occupancy indicator light that turns from green to red when a pod is in use.

faq.q: What does 'GREENGUARD Gold' actually mean, and is Zumbooth really the first in China to get it?
faq.a: GREENGUARD Gold is a stricter air-quality certification than standard GREENGUARD, with lower chemical emission limits. Zumbooth's parent company Hecor states it was the first company in China to receive it for acoustic pods, a claim from the manufacturer, worth confirming directly if it's a deciding factor for your project.

faq.q: Is Zumbooth actually cheaper than building a permanent meeting room?
faq.a: Roughly 50% less, per the manufacturer's own figures, since you're avoiding construction, permitting and permanent renovation costs entirely.

faq.q: Why did a partition wall manufacturer start making acoustic pods?
faq.a: Hecor, Zumbooth's parent company, began in office partition walls in 2012 before expanding into acoustic pods, which explains the construction-grade build quality (aviation-grade aluminum) in a product that isn't actually construction.

faq.q: How do I know if a Zumbooth pod is occupied without opening the door?
faq.a: A built-in indicator light turns from green to red when someone's inside, a small but genuinely useful detail for shared office pods.

faq.q: Who handles a Zumbooth installation, and how long does it take?
faq.a: We handle it ourselves, import through placement and setup, and since there's no construction involved, most installations are considerably faster than a built room would be.

cta.heading: Half the Cost of a Built Room, Gold-Certified Air.
cta.text: Weighing acoustic pods against building a permanent meeting room? Tell us your space and budget, and we'll show you where Zumbooth fits.

editorial.heading: Libero Italy: From the Desk Chair to the Reception Sofa
editorial.opening: Most office chair brands stop at the desk. Libero Italy doesn't, its catalogue runs from individual task chairs through to sofas, benches and stools, so a reception area and a row of desks can share the same design language instead of looking like they came from two different suppliers.
editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Libero Italy to clients who want visual consistency across an office, not just uniform desk chairs, but breakout areas, reception and lounge furniture that actually match the rest of the fit-out, without sourcing a second brand for the soft seating.
editorial.background: Libero Italy's catalogue spans office chairs, sofas, benches and stools, covering both individual desking and shared lounge or breakout spaces. It's typically specified alongside a primary desk chair brand specifically to complete the areas a standard office chair range doesn't cover.

faq.q: Can Libero Italy furnish both desks and lounge areas, or just chairs?
faq.a: Both. Its range covers office chairs alongside sofas, benches and stools, so reception and breakout areas can match the same design language as the desks.

faq.q: Why would I use Libero Italy instead of buying sofas separately?
faq.a: Consistency. Sourcing lounge furniture from the same catalogue as your desk chairs avoids the mismatched look you get from mixing unrelated brands in the same office.

faq.q: Is Libero Italy furniture built for daily commercial use, or more residential-grade?
faq.a: Commercial use. It's specified for offices and workplace fit-outs, not residential settings, so durability is built for daily traffic, not occasional home use.

faq.q: Does installation come with the furniture, or is that arranged separately?
faq.a: It's included. We handle import, specification and installation directly, coordinated with whatever other brands are part of the same fit-out.

faq.q: Can Libero Italy pieces be mixed with other office chair brands in one project?
faq.a: Yes, that's usually how it's used: filling in reception, breakout and lounge furniture around a separate desk chair brand, all delivered on one schedule.

cta.heading: One Design Language, From the Desk to the Lobby.
cta.text: Need your reception, breakout and desk seating to actually match? Tell us your space and we'll show you where Libero Italy fits.

name: Nitrocare
summary: Hospital and ICU furniture engineered for clinical environments and Singapore healthcare facility standards.
description: Nitrocare is a global leader in medical furniture known for its award-winning designs and advanced engineering. The company emphasises sustainability, hygiene and ease of maintenance, manufacturing with eco-friendly processes and high-quality steel components.
Furniconcepts supplies Nitrocare hospital beds, attendant chairs, stretchers and clinical furniture to healthcare facilities across Singapore.

highlights.text: Internationally recognised medical furniture engineering.

highlights.title: Hygiene First
highlights.text: Easy-clean surfaces and materials built for clinical settings.

editorial.heading: Nitrocare: Hospital Furniture With Design Awards to Prove It
editorial.opening: Nitrocare's hospital beds have won Red Dot, iF and German Design Awards, not a common thing to say about ICU furniture. Founded in 2009 as part of Turkey's Gökler Group, the company runs a 60,000m² manufacturing facility in Sivas and holds CE and ISO certification on its medical equipment.

atAGlance.label: Recognition
atAGlance.value: Red Dot, iF and German Design Awards

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Nitrocare to facilities that want documented design and safety credentials, not just a functional bed. Its electric beds use industry-standard Linak or TiMotion actuators rather than proprietary components, so replacement parts and servicing don't lock you into a single supplier down the line.
editorial.background: Nitrocare's range covers hospital beds, ICU beds, dialysis chairs, medical recliners, stretchers, exam chairs, bedside cabinets and overbed tables. Many models use radiolucent bed decks that allow C-arm and X-ray access without transferring the patient, and antimicrobial surfaces suited to infection control.

faq.q: Has Nitrocare actually won design awards, or is that just marketing?
faq.a: It's genuine: Nitrocare's beds have won Red Dot, iF and German Design Awards, recognitions judged independently of the company, not self-issued.

faq.q: Are Nitrocare's electric bed parts proprietary, or can they be serviced by anyone?
faq.a: Its electric beds use Linak or TiMotion actuator systems, industry-standard components used across the medical furniture industry, not a proprietary system. That generally makes replacement parts easier and cheaper to source over the bed's lifetime.

faq.q: Can Nitrocare beds be used for X-ray or C-arm imaging without moving the patient?
faq.a: On models with radiolucent decks (HPL or ABS material), yes. It's worth confirming this feature on the specific bed model you're specifying, since not every Nitrocare bed includes it.

faq.q: Where is Nitrocare actually manufactured?
faq.a: Sivas, Turkey, out of a roughly 60,000m² facility operated by the Gökler Group, which Nitrocare is part of.

faq.q: Do you install Nitrocare beds and furniture yourselves in Singapore?
faq.a: Yes. We handle specification, import and installation directly, and coordinate timing around a facility's operating hours to avoid disrupting patient care.

cta.heading: Award-Winning Design, Serviceable for the Long Run.
cta.text: Furnishing a ward or ICU in Singapore? Tell us your bed count and clinical requirements, and we'll scope Nitrocare against them.

editorial.heading: Jwesys: For Rooms That Need to Change Their Mind
editorial.opening: Jwesys is our specialist for spaces that need to disappear and reappear. Its retractable and telescopic systems use steel-framed, quiet-moving mechanisms built for auditoriums, sports venues and multi-purpose halls that can't dedicate a room to one single use.

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Jwesys to clients who need a highly versatile space that maximises utility and revenue: a school hall that's also an exam venue, a community centre that hosts both assemblies and events. We strategically advise our clients to utilise Jwesys when looking to maximise both spatial versatility and financial return.
editorial.background: Furniconcepts markets Jwesys seating across Dubai, India and Singapore, and its project positioning names auditoriums, sports venues, universities, community halls and schools as typical applications, wider than a single-purpose auditorium brand.

faq.q: Is Jwesys seating durable enough for daily retraction?
faq.a: Yes, that's specifically what it's engineered for. Steel-framed mechanisms built for frequent conversion hold up better under daily folding and unfolding than a system designed for occasional use.

faq.q: How is Jwesys different from a fixed auditorium seating brand?
faq.a: Fixed brands like Audia Italia specialise in permanent installations. Jwesys exists for the opposite problem: a room that has to change function, sometimes daily.

faq.q: Does Jwesys seating suit sports venues, or only school halls?
faq.a: Both. Furniconcepts positions Jwesys across auditoriums, sports venues, universities and community halls, not just school-scale projects.

faq.q: What's the retraction mechanism actually built from?
faq.a: Steel frames with quiet-moving mechanisms, designed to fold and stack cleanly without the noise or wear you'd get from a lighter-duty system.

cta.text: Need a hall that converts between seated and open-floor use? Tell us your venue and how often it needs to switch, and we'll scope the right Jwesys system.

editorial.heading: Audia Italia: The Brand We Reach for When Seating Isn't Enough
editorial.opening: When your project needs to pass a tender panel's fire safety and sustainability checks without giving up genuine Italian design, Audia Italia is the brand we bring in. We handle its import, specification and installation ourselves, right here in Singapore, so you get the certification and the finish without the hassle of managing an overseas supplier.

atAGlance.label: Specialises in
atAGlance.value: Auditorium, cinema, stadium, conference, cruise, university

editorial.whyWeRecommend: Coordinating a full auditorium build usually means juggling separate suppliers for seating, tiering, flooring, stage and walls, and hoping nothing falls through the cracks between them. Audia Italia lets you deal with one supplier instead. And when a tender panel asks for fire-rated (Class 1IM) and sustainability-certified (CAM, ISO 14001) materials, the paperwork actually exists, not just a claim in a sales pitch.
editorial.background: Audia Italia's own project record includes installations for organisations like Google, Microsoft, Qatar Petroleum and the European Council in Strasbourg, alongside universities such as Bologna's Alma Mater and Rome's LUISS. That work is outside Singapore, but it's a fair signal of the manufacturing standard behind what we import here.

faq.q: Is Audia Italia worth the premium over a standard seating brand?
faq.a: If your project is a boutique venue or a full auditorium build, yes: you're paying for turnkey capability and certification most brands don't offer.

faq.q: Which projects actually need Audia Italia's fire and sustainability certifications?
faq.a: Government and institutional tenders almost always ask for them. If you're bidding on a public venue or university project, Class 1IM and CAM certification are usually non-negotiable line items.

faq.q: Who's responsible for getting Audia Italia seating installed correctly?
faq.a: We are. Audia Italia manufactures; we specify, import and install every project in Singapore ourselves, no subcontractor in between.

faq.q: What does it cost to bring in Audia Italia for a project?
faq.a: Depends on scope: seating alone, or a full turnkey build with tiering and stage. Send us your venue details and we'll quote it properly.

cta.heading: Ready to Build More Than a Seating Order?
cta.text: If your project needs the full auditorium or certification a tender panel will check, let's talk about how Audia Italia fits.

editorial.heading: Scab Italy: Proof That Weatherproof Furniture Can Win Design Awards
editorial.opening: Scab Italy has been pioneering technopolymer and polycarbonate seating since the 1970s, materials some buyers assume mean cheap plastic chairs. Its Lisa collection alone has picked up a Red Dot Design Award, a German Design Award and multiple Archiproducts Design Awards, proof that durable, weather-proof material doesn't have to look like it.

atAGlance.label: Facilities
atAGlance.value: Roughly 85,000m² across multiple Italian production units

atAGlance.label: Recognition
atAGlance.value: Red Dot, German Design Award, Archiproducts Design Awards

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Scab Italy for café, restaurant and hotel outdoor projects where furniture needs to survive Singapore's heat and rain without looking like it's built for outdoor survival. Its technopolymer and polycarbonate ranges are stackable, fully recyclable and designed by named collaborators, not generic outdoor furniture with a design afterthought.
editorial.background: Scab Italy collaborates with designers including Alberto Werner Arter, Fabrizio Citton and Roberto Semprini across its collections, and has worked with plastics and technical fabrics since the 1970s. Its chairs carry CATAS resistance certification, the Italian furniture-testing standard, and its materials are stated as 100% recyclable.

faq.q: Is Scab Italy's outdoor furniture actually durable, or just good-looking?
faq.a: Both, that's the point of its material science. Scab has worked with technopolymer and polycarbonate since the 1970s specifically to combine weather resistance with a design finish that doesn't look like standard outdoor plastic.

faq.q: Has Scab Italy won any real design awards, or is that just marketing language?
faq.a: Real and independently judged: a Red Dot Design Award, a German Design Award, and multiple Archiproducts Design Awards, mostly for its Lisa outdoor chair collection.

faq.q: Is Scab Italy a newer brand chasing outdoor furniture trends?
faq.a: No, quite the opposite: it's been manufacturing since 1957, out of Coccaglio in Brescia, with roughly 85,000m² of production facilities across northern Italy today.

faq.q: Is Scab Italy furniture recyclable, or just marketed as sustainable?
faq.a: Its materials are stated as 100% recyclable across multiple sources, consistent with its long-standing focus on technopolymer and polycarbonate rather than mixed or composite materials that are harder to recycle.

faq.q: Do you install Scab Italy furniture yourselves for hospitality projects in Singapore?
faq.a: Yes. We handle specification, import and installation directly, coordinated as part of the same hospitality fit-out as Parin or any other brand in the project.

cta.heading: Weatherproof Doesn't Have to Mean Ugly.
cta.text: Furnishing a café terrace, hotel outdoor area or restaurant floor in Singapore? Tell us your space and we'll show you where Scab Italy fits.

editorial.heading: Markant: The Brand Behind Activity Based Working
editorial.opening: Markant didn't just adopt Activity Based Working, it invented the concept and has spent decades since being its main advocate. Since 1948, the Dutch manufacturer has built its entire System Architecture around workspaces that let people choose the setting that suits what they're actually doing, not a fixed desk for every task.

atAGlance.label: Known for
atAGlance.value: Originating Activity Based Working, modular System Architecture

editorial.whyWeRecommend: We recommend Markant to clients rethinking how their office actually gets used: hybrid teams, activity-based layouts, sit-to-stand health initiatives, rather than a straightforward one-desk-per-person plan. Its modular System Architecture also means a layout can be reconfigured as working patterns change.
editorial.background: Markant's Netherlands operation has an Asia-specific arm, Markant Office Asia, with production in Malaysia and sales offices across the region. Its System Architecture uses interchangeable components across working tables, conference tables and bench configurations, and its MAX range of electric sit-to-stand desks addresses the health risks of prolonged sitting directly.

faq.q: What is 'Activity Based Working,' and why does Markant care about it?
faq.a: It's the idea that people choose a workspace suited to what they're doing in the moment: focus work, a call, a meeting, rather than sitting at one fixed desk all day. Markant originated the concept and builds its whole furniture system around it.

faq.q: Do Markant desks actually help with the health risks of sitting too much?
faq.a: That's the point of the MAX range specifically: electric sit-to-stand desks designed to cut down the hours spent seated, which is linked to real health risks beyond just posture.

faq.q: Is Markant a European brand, or does it manufacture closer to Singapore?
faq.a: Both. It's Dutch, founded in 1948, but runs production in Malaysia through Markant Office Asia, which keeps regional supply chains shorter than importing purely from Europe.

faq.q: Can a Markant layout be reconfigured later, or is it fixed once installed?
faq.a: It can be reconfigured. The System Architecture uses interchangeable components across desks, tables and bench setups, built to be adjusted as working patterns change, not locked in at installation.

faq.q: Is installation handled in-house, or outsourced to a local contractor?
faq.a: In-house. We handle specification, import and installation directly, coordinated as part of the same project as any other brand we supply.

cta.heading: Furniture for How People Actually Work Now.
cta.text: Redesigning around hybrid work or activity-based layouts? Tell us how your team works and we'll show you where Markant fits.

faq.a: Yes, a secondary line of student and auditorium-style seating, alongside its core office chair and system furniture range.

faq.q: Is Merryfair's education seating as strong as its office chairs?
faq.a: It's a secondary line, not the company's main focus. If auditorium-style seating for a school is the primary need, we'd typically point to Audia Italia or Bestuhl first, and consider Merryfair for a project already using it elsewhere.

cta.heading: One Brand or Twelve, We Consolidate Either Way.
cta.text: Need Merryfair as part of a bigger multi-brand order? Tell us what else you're sourcing and we'll put it on one schedule.
